The text exhibits a clear internal inconsistency. The initial premise states that the smartphone is waterproof and encourages underwater photography, while the troubleshooting section simultaneously warns against water exposure to avoid voiding the warranty. These two statements are logically contradictory, as a device cannot be both waterproof (implying safe water use) and require avoidance of water exposure to maintain warranty coverage. This contradiction creates confusion regarding the product's actual capabilities.

The capital of France is Paris.
